generation_policy: Use aggregate categories only. Do not copy development references, hypotheses, specific callsigns, numeric sequences or recordings into synthetic examples.
category_caveats: Categories are heuristic token classes, not verified entity spans.
Calls sign terms do not measure full callsign accuracy.
Digit-format mismatches require review before treating numeric errors as acoustic failures.
Noise, accent, clipping and reference defects require audio review and cannot be inferred from token counts alone.
